OLD CLIP of Reggie resurfaces after all the allegations and back & forth with #KaiCenat … 

He once made it clear that the one bridge he’d never burn or cross was with Kai Cenat. At the time, it sounded like a simple shoutout to someone he considered a genuine friend and brother — but hearing it again now has people looking at the relationship in a completely different light.

Reggie specifically singled out KC3, giving him his flowers and making it clear that, no matter what happened, that was one relationship he wasn’t willing to go against. 

Now today Reggie accused Kai of being a P.D.F towards Rakai and others
